'''Premiere Unlimited '94''' is the second expansion and the first reprint of the base set for [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 12 December 1994. The set consists of 363 cards with images from all seasons of the '''Star Trek: The Next Generation''' television series.

This set is available in 60-card starter decks and 15-card booster packs. There are 36 booster packs in one booster box and 12 starter decks in one starter deck box. The starter decks include a 36 page Rules booklet.

The starter decks contain 45 commons, 13 uncommons, and 2 rares. Each booster pack contains 11 commons, 3 uncommons, and 1 rare.

This set had a similar print run as the '''[[Premiere Limited (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Premiere Limited]]''' set making it as rare.

The difference between this set and '''[[Premiere Limited (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Premiere Limited]]''' are the white borders on the cards.

==Additional Information==

*'''Premiere Unlimited '94''' was printed on 121 card sheets by Carta Mundi, Belgium on Superlux card stock. Each rarity (Common, Uncommon, and Rare) had its own print sheet.
*Each print sheet consisted of an 11 x 11 format.
*The print run for this expansion was 45,900,000 cards.
